summary: Join our Basel III and Financial Regulatory Compliance Training Course to gain vital knowledge and skills for navigating complex financial regulations effective
lede: Basel III training explains the framework’s capital, leverage, liquidity and risk requirements for financial professionals. It is designed for banking, finance, audit, risk and compliance professionals who need to apply these requirements to institutional oversight and reporting. The course covers interpreting the framework’s three pillars, calculating capital adequacy and risk-weighted assets, and assessing liquidity ratios, stress tests and supervisory expectations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals involved in financial governance, risk, and compliance decisions. If your role involves steering your institution through the complexities of regulatory standards, this course is tailored for you.
audience: Chief Risk Officers and Compliance Managers
modules: The Three Pillars of Basel III
Credit, Market, and Operational Risk Management
Basel III and Other Regulatory Frameworks
Future of Banking Regulation: Basel IV and Beyond
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of financial regulations and risk management principles. Familiarity with banking operations and previous exposure to Basel II is recommended.
